source_instruction: i am looking for a women's socks made up of polyester cotton which is washable in machine. also choose black or semi mint rush green color.
query:
I swear the barista at the corner café by my apartment recognized my order before I even opened my mouth this morning, and they slipped me an extra shot of oat milk cold foam for free because I brought in a batch of the chocolate chip cookies I baked last night to share with the whole staff yesterday. On my walk over here, I stopped to pet the chunky orange tabby that hangs out on the fire escape of the laundromat down the block, and it actually hopped down onto the sidewalk to rub against my jeans for a full five minutes instead of darting off like it usually does when strangers get too close. I also noticed the community garden on the next block over finally put up those little hand-painted signs marking all the tomato and basil plots people have been tending all spring, and someone even strung those tiny twinkling solar lights between the fence posts that make the whole spot glow soft gold when the sun starts going down.
Hey, I’m looking through the women’s socks & hosiery section right now for pairs made of polyester cotton that are hand wash only, yeah? I want to grab that one color I always pick, you know the one I mean? I don’t want to spend too much, obviously, so just keep it under whatever’s reasonable for nice everyday socks, yeah? Let me know what options you’ve got that fit what I’m after, thanks!
